## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 24, 2026 - Aug 21, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Terry_, Aug 21, 2026, 1/5: "I hate the new version. I can't even find my over all low and High oxygen level for sleep. it's like a confusing jungle to get the info I want with my Fold phone breaking, my sumsung watch 5 pro getting super slow and limitations which I get constant ads, i thing it's a good time to try Apple phones and watches."
            2. _JWM B_, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "Terrible update, completely ruined the app. Since the latest Samsung Health update, this app has gone downhill fast. The new UI is cluttered and confusing, and honestly feels like a step backward instead of an improvement. Worse, the app crashes constantly, which makes my Samsung Watch practically useless for sports and training. I rely on this thing for tracking workouts, and now I can't trust it to even stay open. This is three steps back, not progress. Really disappointing!"
            3. _Samia Mahmud_, Aug 20, 2026, 3/5: "I prefer Samsung Health because it's easy to use and manage, but lately I've faced a frustrating issue. Some days it records my walking, running, and steps perfectly, while on other days it doesn't detect anything at all. I've searched for a solution but found no helpful information. It's making it difficult to track my health properly. Please look into this glitch and fix it as soon as possible."
<!--/ir-theme-->
